title: Stable Topology in Exactly Flat Bands
abstract: Overcomes fundamental no-go theorems by demonstrating existence of critical topological flat bands (CTFBs) in finite-range hopping models. Wavefunctions are continuous but non-analytic at isolated band touching points. Establishes general construction principle for CTFBs carrying desired topological invariants. Key result for tensor networks: all filled CTFB states admit exact tensor-network representations with finite bond dimensions, providing tractable starting point for strongly correlated topological matter.
key_claims: Critical topological flat bands overcome no-go theorems for flat bands with stable topology
All filled CTFB states admit exact tensor-network representations with finite bond dimension
Power-law correlations in filled CTFB states
